knowledge_gaps: The mechanism remains weakly connected to the diagnosis: gating contextual features supplies no explicit recency, compatibility or unmet-need evidence. History deletion results establish dependence, not stale-interest persistence.

The experiment lacks a declared baseline-versus-adaptive-versus-static-gate comparison, trial allocation and stopping rule. Static channelwise gates would help distinguish input conditioning from learned residual rescaling; compared models must remain separate and never be fused.

Gate initialization preserves baseline outputs only with identical backbone parameters and stochastic realizations. Constructing Linear layers consumes random numbers even before their weights are zeroed, potentially changing later backbone initialization and training randomness. Initialization order and RNG handling need specification.

The gate adds 2D²+D parameters per block. Its multiplier is bounded by approximately 1.1353, and its initial derivative with respect to its logit is approximately 0.1192. Parameter overhead, gradient behavior, weight decay on gate biases and dependence on dropout-corrupted updates need explicit treatment.

Originality 3 and potential 6 are reasonable provisional judgments, but Highway Networks and Gated Residual Networks are closer precedents than ReZero alone. Difficulty 3 describes the local module; complete predictor integration and diagnostic verification remain more demanding.

Reproduction remains incomplete without the actual baseline integration, executable predictor-writer changes, defined gate diagnostic thresholds and measured export parity. No proposed-gate validation results establish improvement; paired uncertainty and adaptive validation reuse also need reporting.
